lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - A Find the eight hidden pictures

details: Find the eight hidden pictures reviews how to identify and spell the unit’s key words.
Look for correct identification of the objects in the picture.
“Class, we have a problem. Some robbers came in the night and they’ve taken some of our school things. I need you to help me find them.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - B Listen and circle

details: Listen and circle continues checking the unit’s key vocabulary and structures. Students listen for specific words, then show understanding by clearly circling ‘O’ if the sentence matches the picture and ‘X’ if it doesn’t.
Look for accurate and confident identification of the target language and the correct circling of ‘O’ or ‘X’.
“We’re still missing four items. Can you help me listen and tell me what they are?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.71 - A Look and match

details: Look and match continues checking word-picture connections. Students match the parts of the images, then show understanding by matching the words to the completed pictures.
Look for clear, neat lines and correct word-picture matching.
“I've just had an update from the police.. They think they’ve found our things, but the bad news is that everything has been cut in half! Can you help me match them back up?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.71 - B Look and tick

details: Look and tick reviews one of the key structures from the unit (‘this’ and ‘that’). Students look at the pictures and decide if they are near or far away before choosing the correct question.
Look for correct identification of all four pictures, and accurate ticking of the boxes.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.20 - Speaking Toss a coin. Then ask and answer.

details: This Speaking activity helps students practise their speaking skills in relation to the target language. This strengthens fluency, demonstrates their ability to follow instructions and gives them an opportunity to demonstrate turn taking skills.
Look for students moving one space if the coin lands on heads and two spaces for tails, the correct identification of the objects in the pictures, and the correct use of ‘this’ and ‘that’.
“I’m so relieved our items have been returned,. Can you work together to help me check we’ve got everything back?”
